sources.title: Model Zoo and Pre-trained Models | facebookresearch/deit | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Purpose and Scope This document provides a comprehensive overview of all pre-trained models available in the DeiT repository, including their performance metrics, parameter counts, computational requirements, and access methods. It covers models from multiple architecture families, including DeiT, CaiT, ResMLP, PatchConvnet, and DeiT III.

sources.title: dnhkng/RYS-XLarge · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is a new kind of model optimization. It is based on a new method for the analysis of the functional role of layers within the transformer stack, and on layer duplication (self-merging) to increase intelligence.
